_comment: CareConnect - Provider Verification Documents (IT Team Handover). One Firestore doc per provider type in collection 'verification_requirements'. A profile stays non-bookable until every document with mandatory=true is uploaded and approved by admin. 'matchField'/'matchValues' pick a sub-type from the provider profile; otherwise the role's isDefault doc is used. 'legacyField' = older profile field so documents uploaded before this system still count.
